title: Forms: Validate What Visitors Type | Orchard Core
description:
A form that accepts empty fields collects nothing useful, and a visitor who makes a mistake needs to see what to fix.

In the Forms module, a workflow checks the submitted values and records an error for each one that fails. The form displays those errors with a Validation Summary widget and the Validation option of its inputs, and the workflow sends the visitor back to the form with the messages.

In this video:
• How validation works: rules in a workflow, messages on the form
• Show errors on the form: a summary and a message under each field
• Check the values in a workflow: Validate Form Field, Validate Form and the way back
• Try the form: empty, partly filled and complete
